task: Investigate whether an early dark energy (EDE) model can alleviate the acoustic tension between measurements from the cosmic microwave background (CMB) and baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO)
inputs: CMB data from Planck and ACT
outputs: Constraints on cosmological parameters (Ωm, H₀, σ₈, etc.) from model fitting
Comparison of goodness-of-fit (Δχ²) for ΛCDM, EDE, and w₀wₐ models
Posterior distributions of EDE parameters (f_EDE, log₁₀a_c)
